source_claim: The official Blend S anime character page names Akizuki Koyo, Amano Miu, Hinata Kaho, Hoshikawa Mafuyu, Kanzaki Hideri, and Sakuranomiya Maika as characters in the Blend S story. The same official site identifies the title as Blend S and credits the manga/rightsholder production committee. This first-party roster supports direct HOME for all six exact campaign members.
notes: The official character page (https://blend-s.jp/sp/character/) directly names all six current members: 秋月紅葉, 天野美雨, 日向夏帆, 星川麻冬, 神崎ひでり, 桜ノ宮苺香. The official staff/cast and site pages identify the work as TV anime 『ブレンド・S』, adapted from 中山幸’s manga serialized in 芳文社「まんがタイムきららキャラット」; the site copyright is © 中山幸・芳文社／ブレンド・S製作委員会. The canonical work root key is `blend_s`. Direct HOME only; no separate character identity relation is asserted.
